stemMd: A company offers plan One at 30 euros plus 2 euros per use, and plan Two at 54 euros plus 1 euro per use. At how many uses do costs match?
explanationMd: Equate 30+2n=54+n. Subtracting n and 30 gives n=24. Both plans then cost 78 euros.

distractorRationale.a: Divides the fixed-charge difference by the wrong variable rate.
distractorRationale.d: Adds fixed fees instead of taking their difference.
